title: 200 Million Termite Mounds Cover an Area the Size of Britain

scenes.text: Termites built 200 million mounds you can see from space.
They're in northeastern Brazil, in a region called the Caatinga.
Each mound is about eight feet tall and thirty feet across.
Together they cover an area the size of Great Britain.
The termites dug out ten cubic kilometers of soil, as much as 4,000 Great Pyramids.
Some are close to 4,000 years old. All made by one tiny insect.

description:
Termites built 200 million mounds you can see from space.
In northeastern Brazil they cover an area about the size of Great Britain, and some are almost 4,000 years old.
What is the biggest thing you have seen an insect build?
first_comment: Built by one tiny species for nearly 4,000 years. Which is crazier: the size or the age?
